name: arena
purpose: Compare isolated attempts at the same artifact, pick a maintainable base, graft the strongest rejected-candidate ideas coherently and verify the synthesis.
triggers: one attempt at a non-trivial artifact would lock in the wrong shape
inputs: Authorized artifact task and shared grounding
Runner and cross-judge preferences, observed capabilities and isolated output paths
outputs: Adjacent synthesis note with base, judge verdict, graft sources, rejections, dropouts and verification
ordinaryExample: Compare two cache API designs in isolated directories, judge completed candidates, select the cleaner boundary and adapt one useful idea from the other design.
capabilityLimits: Independent candidates and fresh judging require exposed authorized workers and inspected artifacts.
Sequential alternatives are reduced capability; one survivor is incomplete competition.
Requested models do not prove actual model diversity.
Required missing capabilities or denied writes block their gates.
Host behavior has not been tested.
